variants.headline: Company lays off many workers
variants.sub: Many workers have been laid off by a company in the colony.
variants.body:
A company has laid off many workers in {colony}. The scale is described as large, but a specific number is not supplied here. In assessing {target}, readers should distinguish the loss of jobs from an invented cause, severance arrangement or account of what will happen to those affected.

Many people have lost their work at a company. That is the human centre of this story. It needs neither an invented tearful interview nor a convenient promise that everything will be fine. Readers can demand a serious standard of responsibility without being given a fictional household to feel for.

We hold {target} to account critically. A large loss of jobs is not a minor adjustment in the lives of workers, and its stewardship deserves a more demanding standard than a convenient abstraction. Readers deserve a clear story and a straight answer about responsibility.
